facts_found: Step 1 of the credit card closure process is to verify the customer's identity using standard verification procedures before any closure action. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_002]

Closure eligibility requires all of: outstanding balance of $0.00, no active/pending transaction disputes, account open at least 60 days, and no pending replacement card (received/activated or order cancelled). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_001]

The retention protocol checks eligibility in this order: pending disputes, pending replacement cards, minimum 60-day account age, then outstanding balance; if any requirement is unmet, explain what must be resolved and do not proceed with retention offers. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_003]

Closure is processed by the agent with the tool close_credit_card_account_7834 taking credit_card_account_id and user_id (user_id must match the authenticated user); no human-agent-only restriction is documented for credit card closure. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_002]

Before making retention offers, the agent must call get_closure_reason_history_8293 with credit_card_account_id; if closure-reason records exist for that account within the past year, retention offers are skipped and the closure is processed directly. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_003]

The closure reason must be logged with log_credit_card_closure_reason_4521 using exactly three arguments: credit_card_account_id, user_id, and closure_reason. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_003]

For the 'found a better card' reason, the agent asks what features attracted the customer and, if Rho-Bank offers a card with similar or better benefits, offers to help them apply instead of closing; for 'not using the card', the agent reminds them of benefits and suggests a recurring subscription to keep the card active. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_003]

If the customer still wants to close, exactly one retention offer is made based on card tier: entry-tier 500 bonus points or $5 statement credit; mid-tier 2,000 bonus points or $20 statement credit; premium and above 5,000 bonus points or $50 statement credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_003]
Business Silver Rewards Card is classified as a Mid Tier card (grouped with Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

If the customer declines the retention offer (or retention was skipped due to a prior attempt within a year), the agent thanks them and proceeds with closure without applying pressure. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_003]
Unredeemed rewards can be redeemed for 45 days after the closure request; after that they are permanently forfeited. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_001]

If the annual fee posted recently, a full refund may apply when closure occurs within 37 days of the fee charge; after that window no refund is provided. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_001]

For cash back cards including Business Silver Rewards Card, stored 'points' are cash back redeemable at 1 point = $0.01 as a statement credit or a credit to the customer's Rho-Bank checking account. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

Statement credit and Rho-Bank checking-account-credit redemptions require a minimum of 500 points ($5.00); travel portal redemption is 1.25 cents/point (min 2,500 points); airline miles transfers are not available for Business Silver Rewards Card (only Gold, Platinum, Diamond Elite, Business Platinum). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_008]
Post-closure, the customer receives a confirmation email and a final statement within several business days. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_002]

Pending replacement orders are checked with get_pending_replacement_orders_5765 (parameter credit_card_account_id) immediately before initiating closure; any non-final order (pending/shipped) blocks closure until delivered or cancelled. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_005]

A remaining balance can be paid from a Rho-Bank checking account using the discoverable agent tool pay_credit_card_from_checking_9182 (unlock then call), after identity verification and customer authorization; the amount cannot exceed the checking balance or the card's outstanding balance. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_009]

Retention statement credits are applied with apply_statement_credit_8472 (unlock via unlock_discoverable_agent_tool, then call via call_discoverable_agent_tool) using user_id, credit_card_account_id, amount (positive dollars) and reason 'retention_offer'. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]

Closing a credit card may affect the customer's credit score by reducing total available credit and affecting the credit utilization ratio, especially for high-limit or long-standing accounts. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_001]

An alternative to closure for fee-driven churn is a permanent downgrade to a no-annual-fee card in the same category (business to Business Bronze Rewards Card), preserving account history, account number and credit line, with unredeemed rewards transferring at the same value. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_008]

Annual-fee-waiver retention (2+ years tenure) uses apply_credit_card_account_flag_6147 with flag_type 'annual_fee_waived', expiration_date one year out in MM/DD/YYYY, and reason 'loyalty_benefit'. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_003]
